description: Single, wages and interest, standard deduction
working: Federal: AGI 93,000 - 16,100 = 76,900; tax 1,240 + 12% x 38,000 = 4,560 + 22% x 26,500 = 5,830 -> 11,630. Arizona (Form 140): AGI 93,000; no subtractions; standard deduction 15,750 (HB 4168); no exemptions or credits. Taxable 93,000 - 15,750 = 77,250 x 2.5% = 1,931.25.

description: Joint, both 65+, 25% long-term gain subtraction, age-65 exemptions and senior subtraction
working: Federal: AGI 115,000; standard deduction 32,200 + 2 x 1,650 = 35,500; senior deduction 2 x 6,000 = 12,000 (AGI under 150,000); taxable 67,500, all of it gains inside the 0% band (to 98,900), so tax 0. Arizona: AGI 115,000; subtract 25% of 80,000 long-term gain = 20,000 (qualified dividends not eligible); subtract federal senior deduction 12,000; standard deduction 31,500 (HB 4168, no 65+ add-on); age-65 exemptions 2 x 2,100 = 4,200. Taxable = 115,000 - 20,000 - 12,000 - 31,500 - 4,200 = 47,300. Tax 47,300 x 2.5% = 1,182.50. No dependents, so no credit.
